notes: Master-difficulty quest-cape gate. Skill reqs alone are steep (65 Crafting/60 Slayer/60 Smithing/60 Fishing/55 Runecraft, 60 Mining boostable), and the quest chain is deep: The Fremennik Isles -> The Fremennik Trials; Lunar Diplomacy -> Lost City + Rune Mysteries + Shilo Village -> Jungle Potion -> Druidic Ritual; Mountain Daughter; Heroes' Quest -> Dragon Slayer I + Lost City + Merlin's Crystal + Shield of Arrav -- roughly 10 prior quests deep before you can even start. Walkthrough: investigate a basilisk attack in Rellekka, get framed and exiled, then gather 3 components in any order (a Fremennik shield from dagannoth/market NPC drops or free from Bardur with a Ring of charos(a); Lunar glass + an enchanted V's sigil made via Lunar Isle/Astral Altar/smithing; a Polishing rock from a geyser puzzle at Mountain Camp) to reforge V's shield. notes: Investigate Menaphos's lockdown for the Al Kharid spy Maisa at her campsite east of Sophanem (reachable after quest-start via fairy ring AKP or a Communed Pharaoh's sceptre). Defeat the level-174 Head Menaphite Guard at the blocked Jaltevas Pyramid entrance without Protect from Melee (it deals 1/3 max HP through the prayer). At the Ruins of Ullek, light a furnace with coal, dig up a passcode-locked chest (1118513), craft and place a scarab emblem on a pillar (facing pincers-up), then fight through two level-119 Scarab Mages and disable timed lever traps in a corridor maze. Solve the Riddle of the Tomb by matching per-player emblem clues (item/god order) to the correct urns, then grab a rusty key from the spirit's room. Use ranged to fight the level-379 Champion of Scabaras (alternates magic/melee — stay at range, destroy its 20hp Shadow Rift fast, kill its poison-swarm summon quickly, avoid its 4-tile Shadow Burst). At Nardah, feed a crocodile at the River Elid to retrieve a Lily of the Elid, then help Zahur balance her chemistry-heat puzzle (max the middle/right bars, halve the right, lower the middle to finish) for a pox cure to deliver to the High Priest in Sophanem. Finally return to the necropolis and defeat the level-351 Menaphite Akh (melee; dodge her lightning-bolt twitch attack by standing behind/beside her; kill her summoned Menaphite Shadow quickly or it can swap places with her) to complete the quest.

notes: Grandmaster capstone: the Ancient Vault hub has 4 empty statues, one per medallion looted from the 'Forgotten Four' bosses guarding fragments of the fallen Empty Lord's empire. Familiar Faces: solve a mural/mining intro at the Digsite then kill the Ancient Guardian (shield regens unless meleed; dodge falling rocks by avoiding shadowed tiles) and solve a totem/cell golem puzzle. Vardorvis: sail to the Stranglewood, defend Kasonde from strangled for 3 minutes with barricades/satchels, brew a strangler serum from gathered herbs, kill Vardorvis (slash weapon, dodge axes/root splats/prayer-disabling darts) then Kasonde himself (ranged/kite, avoid poison splats, out-DPS his healing). Perseriya: through Guardians of the Rift's Scar, solve 3 randomized puzzle rooms (nerve-combination circuits, cerebral-orb maze, rune-nerve crafting) to burn 3 ships, then fight the Leviathan with Ranged+Shadow spells (prayer-switch by attack colour, stun and hit its back). Duke Sucellus: escape a prison cell, solve gate-code puzzles (chest passwords/combinations) while dodging Jhallan, then defeat the sleeping Duke via a mushroom-poison mechanic and dodge his ice-spike/acid/eye-gaze attacks behind pillars. The Whisperer: navigate the Shadow Realm of Lassar's undercity collecting shadow-torch schematics and keys while managing a sanity meter, then fight a magic-weak boss with frequent prayer switches. After all 4 medallions are placed, the finale ("The Desert Treasure") has you fight a Mysterious Figure, then Sliske's four wights one after another (Forsaken Assassin, Ketla the Unworthy, Kasonde the Craven, Persten the Deceitful -- each with distinct dodge mechanics) before a final cutscene with Azzanadra.

Investigate a mural under Crandor, then find and solve a 24-piece jigsaw map on Fossil Island, build a rowboat to Lithkren, and read a skeleton's diary. Reforge the key at the Ancient Cavern by casting Fire Wave/Surge on 3 dragon heads, then open the Lithkren doors. Rally Varrock/Falador/Ardougne (or Kandarin) rulers for 'A World United', then 'The Assault': defend a ship from a boarding raid, fight through checkpointed waves of increasingly dangerous dragons (green/blue, then black/steel/brutal red, then mithril/adamant/rune -- the last two have hazardous specials needing antidote++/insulated boots), and finish with a 4-phase Galvek fight requiring full dragonfire protection and phase-specific dodges (fire traps, stat-drain beam, wave-gaps, earth-bind projectiles).

notes: Novice Hunter-skill quest, no series. Charlie the zookeeper needs help finding huntsman Nickolaus, missing near Eagles' Peak west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Find his tent, pick up a bird book that drops a metal feather, and use it to open the mountain-top door into Eagles' Peak Dungeon. Shout to Nickolaus, trapped by a giant eagle, then craft two eagle costumes (10 eagle feathers + swamp tar + yellow dye + 50 coins at Varrock's Fancy Dress Shop) so you can both disguise as eagles. To open the eagle door to Nickolaus you first need three feathers: bronze (defeat a net trap via four corner winches), silver (Hunter 27 to read a pedestal trail leading to a hidden tunnel, then kill or threaten a level 13 kebbit), and gold (solve a bird-seed/lever puzzle moving eagle statues and wing-gates through a specific lever/feeder sequence, reset lever available if you mess it up). Use all three feathers on the eagle door, wear the disguise to pass the guard eagle, then learn to catch ferrets from Nickolaus (no box trap needed for this part) and deliver a ferret to Charlie at Ardougne Zoo to finish.

notes: Second Elemental Workshop-series quest. Find a beaten book with a scroll in the Exam Centre library south of the Digsite, read both, then head to the Elemental Workshop (same entry as EW1). notes: Two-trip Entrana quest that unlocks the balloon transport network -- explicitly a hard prerequisite for Monkey Madness II's Gnome Stronghold route. Trip 1: gather papyrus/candle/dye/silk/sand-filled sacks around Entrana to help Auguste build a balloon frame. length: Long (must wait for several crops to grow)
notes: Long quest, mostly farming-timer-gated. Talk to Ellamaria then the Wise Old Man in Draynor (wearing ring of charos) to pass a quiz. Grow seeds for 5 NPCs to trade up to rarer seeds: Lyra (west of Port Phasmatys, fairy ring AJQ) grows onions for orchid seeds; Kragen (north Ardougne, fairy ring BJR) grows cabbages for snowdrop seeds; Elstan (south Falador) grows marigolds for delphinium seeds; Dantaera (Catherby) needs a cutting from the White Tree on Ice Mountain grown in a filled plant pot; Brother Althric (Edgeville monastery) needs the ring of charos(a) thrown down the well then retrieved with a fishing rod, plus rune dust used on a plant cure for diseased vines, for rose seeds; Bernald (behind Burthorpe pub) similarly needs a plant-cure/rune-dust vine cure via Alain at the Taverley tree patch, for vine seeds. Then move two statues via trolley (Lumbridge king statue east across the bridge to the garden's east plinth; Falador Saradomin statue north through the gate, cutscene, to the south plinth). notes: Master quest, no series, heavy fairy-tale references. Collector Sylas wants two rare items for his magic beans: a feather from the griffin Grimgnash on White Wolf Mountain (tell him an escalating violent bedtime story via specific dialogue options or take 20% current HP damage) and a helmet from dwarf Rupert, imprisoned in a tower between Goblin Village and Ice Mountain. Climb the tower's crumbling east wall (Thieving 58) to reach Rupert, then climb his lowered beard (Agility 59) to talk to him; Princess Miazrqa will free him only if you retrieve her pendant, stolen by a mouse and hidden in the Witch's House basement behind an electric-shocking gate (leather gloves avoid 17 damage) and a piano puzzle (play notes EFEDCAEGA). Shrink with a herblore-brewed potion (Herblore 52) to enter the mouse hole, navigate nail-wall ladders past level 95 mice to the pendant, then trade it to Miazrqa for Rupert's helmet. Give both items to Sylas for magic beans, plant them near Taverley's tree patch, then climb the fast-growing beanstalk (Agility 59, no followers allowed) to fight Glod, a level 118-to-138 cloud giant weak to Magic who quakes to drain Prayer and heals himself. Loot includes a golden goblin and gems; use the spare shrinking potion on the beanstalk then chop it down (Woodcutting 71) and return to Sylas for the reward.

notes: Second Camelot-series quest. King Arthur sends the player after the Holy grail; Merlin points to Entrana and Sir Galahad. Visit Entrana (weapons/armour must be deposited for the monks) and meet a mysterious crone who explains a Fisher King needs help. Get a holy table napkin from Galahad west of McGrubor's Woods, then grab two magic whistles from a room in Draynor Manor. Travel to Brimhaven, head to the guard tower north of the goldmine, and blow a whistle to enter the Fisher King's Realm. Kill the Black Knight Titan (level 120, +1000 magic/ranged defence, flinchable) but the killing blow must be dealt with Excalibur or he heals to full. Ring the grail bell to meet the ailing Fisher King, who asks you to find his son Percival. Get a magic gold feather from King Arthur, follow it to Goblin Village, and find Percival hiding in sacks in the east house; give him a magic whistle. Return to the Fisher Realm (fairy ring code BJR works now) where Percival has become king, then take the Holy grail from upstairs and return it to King Arthur.

notes: Sequel to Land of the Goblins. Drink goblin potion to enter the temple disguised, THEN equip ghostspeak amulet + ring of visibility inside the crypt (equipping too early gets you expelled). Hopespear the ghost prophet asks you to free 5 goblin high priests' souls by rekilling them completely unequipped (no weapons/spells/armour -- jewellery like ghostspeak/ring is fine, but Morytania legs are not) and collecting each one's bones before summoning the next (old bones despawn otherwise). Priests: Snothead (32, SW), Snailfeet (56, SE), Mosschin (88, NW), Redeyes (121, NE, stat-draining), Strongbones (184, N, hardest -- summons skoblins, drains stats, hits up to 18; recommended 70+ melee/Prayer for Piety or Chivalry). Can restock/bank between fights (goblin potion re-needed to re-enter, ghostspeak not). Finish by fairy-ringing to Yu'biusk (code BLQ) and burying the collected bones (can be done in batches).
summary: Rekill 5 unequipped goblin high priests and bury their bones at Yu'biusk to free their souls for Hopespear.

notes: Must own a cat and beat a level-91 Possessed Priest plus one randomly-assigned level 75-81 elemental guardian (Apmeken/Crondis/Scabaras magic, or Het melee - determined by which canopic jar you're given). Give the Wanderer a tinderbox+waterskin(4), enter the pyramid (no teleporting out once inside - aggressive lvl-84 mummies + poison scarabs, use minimap-click nav to dodge traps, jump the pit at 20%+ run energy). Solve a golden-bird door puzzle to trigger flashback 1. Drop your cat to answer the Sphinx's riddle (answer: 9) or lose the cat, then see the High Priest. Flashback 2: re-enter pyramid, take the correct canopic jar from the west room, kill the guardian that spawns, take the jar out (crossing the pit twice), then return and drop the jar back before leaving. Prep for the ceremony: give the Embalmer linen+salt+sap, give the Carpenter willow logs for a holy symbol. Flashback 3: use the holy symbol on a sarcophagus in the east room, kill the level-91 Possessed Priest, talk High Priest. Flashback 4: talk High Priest again in the temple to finish. Post-quest: equipping the catspeak amulet and asking your cat about "being confused" unlocks bonus lore cutscenes. High spine value: opens Sophanem/Menaphos region access.

Flow: at Sinclair Mansion, break in via smashed east window, grab scrap paper + address form + black knight helm from bookcase, give all 3 to guard then talk Gossip. At Black Knights' Fortress (west of Edgeville): get an Animate rock scroll from Wizard Cromperty in Ardougne first, wear full black armour to enter through the south sturdy door, push the north wall, climb down, free King Arthur from his statue using granite, give him the bronze med helm + iron chainbody, then report to King Arthur at Camelot's round table to finish. notes: Master-difficulty capstone quest, one of the deepest prereq chains in the game (Family Crest, Heroes' Quest incl. Shield of Arrav/Lost City/Merlin's Crystal/Dragon Slayer I, Shilo Village line, Underground Pass line, Waterfall Quest, 107 QP). Must be able to beat a level-187 demon (Nezikchened, fought up to 3x). Flow: talk Radimus Erkle at the guild, travel to Kharazi Jungle south of Shilo Village, chop through and map all 3 jungle sections with Radimus notes, get bullroarer from a Jungle forester, summon Gujuo, crawl into Mossy rock cave (50 Agility). Smith a golden bowl (2 gold bars + hammer), have Gujuo enchant it (42+ Prayer, can fail), fill with sacred water from the pool, squeeze through a bookcase crevice, lockpick a gate, smash 3 boulders, force a 2nd gate (50 Str), place gems on carved rocks by color to open a marked wall (Soul/Mind/Earth/Law/Law rune order) and get the binding book. Douse Ungadulu's fire with the bowl, bind him with the book, fight and kill Nezikchened (prayer drained to 1/10 at fight start; ranged/melee+protect-melee recommended, he has high magic resist). Get Yommi tree seeds from Ungadulu, water them, brew a bravery potion (ardrigal + snake weed + vial water) for a branching "evil" (short, kill Viyeldi for a glowing dagger) or "good" (long, cast Holy Force on Zekin) path through a second cave to restore the water source, fighting 3 named skeletons (lvl 106/100/92) for crystal pieces either way. Grow+carve a Yommi totem from the restored tree, use on an old totem pole, survive 4 unavoidable melee hits (up to 72 dmg total, pray Protect Melee) while Nezikchened respawns after each of 3 skeletons, get gilded totem from Gujuo. Hand gilded totem + notes to Radimus at the guild, pick 4 skills for the 30k xp reward, finish. Very high spine value as a QP/skill-chain gate for later quests + the quest-cape line.
summary: Master-tier capstone quest through Kharazi Jungle, ending in defeating the level-187 demon Nezikchened for a choice of skill xp.

Get seal of passage from Brundt the Chieftain, sail to Lunar Isle with Captain Bentley (talk to 5 crew NPCs in strict order, then find 5 hidden symbols with a lit lantern around the ship). On Lunar Isle: kill Suqah (safespottable, lvl 111) for a tooth, brew a waking-sleep potion for Baba Yaga/Oneiromancer. Charge a Dramen staff at all 4 elemental altars (air/fire/water/earth, in order) to make a Lunar staff, hand to Oneiromancer. Mine+smelt lunar ore into a lunar helm; solve Pauline Polaris name-guess dialogue; kill more Suqah for a special tiara + 4 hides, tan hides, craft full lunar gear (torso/trousers/gloves/boots); dig up blue flowers west of the two bridges for the lunar ring; give the Oneiromancer all lunar gear then get it back. Enter the Dream World: light ceremonial brazier with waking-sleep-soaked kindling, then complete 6 mini-puzzles at colored platforms (dice-sum guessing, number-sequence pattern, 20-log chopping race, memorize-and-cross a Dream Puffs stepping-stone maze, hurdle race, copy-the-emote) before fighting and killing Me (level 79, safespottable, no gear switching allowed once in the dream, can't teleport out). notes: The dwarven town Cam Torum's underground temple Neypotzli has stirred 3 sealed ancient bosses. Kill a Sulphur Nagua guarding the entrance, enter the city, and meet Jessamine, Attala, Zuma. Build 3 camps in the dungeon's corner areas (Ancient Prison, Streambound Cavern, Earthbound Cavern) using building supplies. Get water and earth talismans from Attala, have them infused (magic shop's Nahta, then the blacksmith), then dowse hot/cold with both talismans to locate the hidden NPC Eyatlalli (location varies per player). Gather 3 ritual items around the dungeon (moonlight grub paste, bream scales from fishing, a trapped moss lizard's tail) and start the ritual. Fight all 3 Moons of Peril in their own chambers: Blue Moon (crush-weak; weapon-freeze and brazier-relight specials), Blood Moon (slash-weak; raining-blood pools and blood-jaguar specials), Eclipse Moon (stab-weak; rotating shield and clone-facing specials) -- stand in a rotating safe-damage circle throughout, damage during specials still counts. Return to the Antechamber and speak to Eyatlalli to finish.

notes: Second Miscellania-series quest. As regent, investigate thefts threatening war between Miscellania and Etceteria; talking to citizens on both sides reveals soldiers demanded tithes and were refused. King Vargas sends you to the Sailor at the docks, who mentions visiting children; get a signed scroll from Vargas to access the dungeon under Miscellania Castle. Deeper in, swing across water with a rope, cross slippery rocks with a plank (avoid steam vents and falling rocks), and collect 5 pages of a burnt diary from fire remains, reading it before the final crevice. Meet the runaway Fremennik-trial children (a Scooby-Doo parody) who admit to staging the whole conflict, then kill the Giant Sea Snake (level 149, 100 HP, poison hits up to 9 -- antipoison strongly recommended) in an instanced boss room. notes: Grandmaster capstone that unlocks Prifddinas. Disguise as an Ardougne knight (dyed helm + tabard) to free Elena from Ardougne Castle's dungeon, infiltrate West Ardougne as a mourner to stir unrest (burn grain sacks, talk to townsfolk), then switch back to knight gear to rile up East Ardougne merchants. Fight two waves of guards ('Battle of West Ardougne' at Mourner HQ, 'Battle of East Ardougne' at the castle), triggering exile to Lletya. Learn Arianwyn's rebellion plan, then solve a six-pillar light puzzle at Baxtorian Falls (6 items keyed to per-pillar riddle clues) to reach the Well of Voyage. Grow a cadantine seed, get a crystal seed enchanted, then track down Lord Amlodd and Lady Trahaearn (repairing an elderly elf's mechanism with a runite bar) to reach the Enchanted Valley and brew an inversion potion. Solve the Grand Library's nine house-seal puzzles (separate sub-guide), then find Lord Crwys and Lady Hefin, retrieve an orb of light by killing two Iorwerth guards, track Ysgawyn via a footprint/clue trail, and survive the attack on Lletya -- a bow fight against Arianwyn (dodge orange 1x1 bomb arrows, re-enable prayers after purple ones). Solve a five-symbol clue chain across Lletya and outdoor dig sites to find Lady Ithell and Lady Meilyr, then defend a dwarf camp for 4 minutes inside the Underground Pass and beat Essyllt, before the finale: a magic-only boss fight against the Fragment of Seren with 4 recurring specials (teleport-to-boss, copy/split identification, spawned healing orbs to snipe, and a near-max-hit freeze nuke requiring overheal via Saradomin brews). Completing it opens Prifddinas.

notes: Unnamed-in-game miniquest (config name spiritofadventure_*), released 23 July 2025 with Varlamore: The Final Dawn. Wearing a ghostspeak amulet, talk to ghost Bernina, who died in the wreck that named Shipwreck Cove and lost her diamond necklace to a salvager. Find salvager Jasper at Salvager Overlook (he sold it on due to bad luck) to learn it went to a mountain climber. Grab logs+tinderbox from houses south of Jasper, climb the Proudspire to find climber Bernard, light a fire for him (with the logs/tinderbox) to learn he's carrying the necklace up the mountain to honour his late mother -- who turns out to be Bernina. Return to Bernina to relay this; she teleports to join Bernard atop the Proudspire. Return to Bernard so you can ghost-interpret for the reunion, then climb to the peak obelisk and speak to Bernard there to finish. No combat, no item/xp reward.
summary: Help ghost Bernina reunite with mountain climber Bernard atop the Proudspire by tracing her lost necklace.

notes: Must beat 3 level-75 golems (white/grey/black), each weak to a different melee style (stab/slash/crush respectively) or a ranged/magic water-channel puzzle. Talk Awusah then Ghaslor the Elder for the ballad, find torn robe top+bottom in a cupboard, repair with needle+thread and equip (Robes of Elidinis), telegrab an ancestral key. Follow the river north to a waterfall cave, rope the overhanging root, use the ancestral key wearing the robes to open the door. Kill white golem (stab) then clear its water channel via Thieving; kill grey golem (slash) then clear via pickaxe; kill black golem (crush) then clear via Ranged/Magic on a target. Talk to a spirit through the north door, return to Nardah. Separately: take a genie's shoes by Awusah's door, knife them for a sole, find a crevice west of the general store, rope it, talk to and strike a deal with the Genie for a statuette, then place the statuette on the shrine plinth north of the fountain to finish. Region-opener (Nardah/desert), no known deeper dependency; useful all-purpose restoration shrine unlock.
summary: Defeat 3 golems guarding water channels, then trade with a genie to unlock the Nardah shrine to Elidinis.

start.location: Piscatoris Fishing Colony (boat west of Tree Gnome Stronghold)

notes: One Small Favour's chain (Rune Mysteries, Shilo Village -> Jungle Potion -> Druidic Ritual) and Garden of Tranquillity's chain (Creature of Fenkenstrain -> Priest in Peril, The Restless Ghost) are prerequisites, flattened. Must be able to defeat a combat level 170 monster (Sea Troll Queen: magic+melee, drains prayer). Talk to Herman Caranos, then the Wise Old Man in Draynor, then return to the colony (fight through level 79 sea trolls, collect 7 bones, enter and speak to Herman). Repair the colony: light the firebox, press iron bars into sheets to repair the perimeter wall, fish and cook 5 monkfish for Arnold Lydspor while fending off increasingly tough sea trolls, then talk to the Wise Old Man/Herman. Raise an army: visit Wizard Frumscone in the Wizards' Guild basement, then Malignius Mortifer south of Falador (get brown apron), make a pot+lid at the Crafting Guild into an airtight pot (don't wear Saradomin gear near Malignius), teleport back to the colony. Final battle: fight and kill the Sea Troll Queen (Protect from Magic while meleeing, or use ranged). Note: starting this quest temporarily blocks the Sir Amik Varze RFD subquest until 'Repairing the Colony' is done; the colony is instanced during the quest so Treasure Trail unlocks only apply after full completion.
summary: Repair the Piscatoris Fishing Colony's defenses, raise an army, then defeat the Sea Troll Queen to unlock the colony.

notes: Jungle Potion's own Druidic Ritual requirement is inherited/flattened. Prep ahead: banana rum (slice a banana onto Karamjan rum bought from Zembo at Musa Point, quest-safe to teleport with), burnt jogre bones (burn jogre bones with a tinderbox, needs 30 Firemaking or use a furnace), pasty jogre bones (fish 45 raw karambwanji near fairy ring CKR, grind one into paste, apply to burnt bones, cook - don't bury), and a karambwan-poisoned spear (cook a raw karambwan into a poison karambwan, grind it, apply paste to spear). Talk to Timfraku to start, then to Lubufu (help him fish, learn Karambwan fishing, lose/regain a vessel for a spare). Head to fairy ring DKP: give Tiadeche a baited karambwan vessel, then go to CKR and find Tamayu at the mine - give him the agility potion and poisoned spear, watch him fight the Shaikahan, then bring him a monkey corpse and a seaweed-monkey-skin sandwich. Cross to Cairn Isle and give Tinsay the rum, sandwich, and marinated jogre bones for a crafting manual; give the manual to Tiadeche to get him to agree to return. Return to Timfraku to finish; optionally talk to Tiadeche, Tinsay, and Tamayu afterward for extra XP/rewards.

notes: Must be able to defeat a level 84 Fire Warrior of Lesarkus with Ranged. Choice quest with a good path (side with Guardians of Armadyl, kill Lucien level 14) or evil path (steal the Staff of Armadyl for Lucien, may need to kill a safespottable level 43 Guardian of Armadyl). Enter the temple dungeon south of the Ranging Guild; get boots of lightness from behind a web (needs light source+knife), equip Pendant of Lucien to pass the north gate, cross a lava bridge at -1kg or less, take a lever, cross back and attach the lever to a bracket then pull it, loot ice arrows from chests along an icy path (16 arrows enough with Ava's + 60 Ranged). Go back through the north gate, search-and-pull another lever (needs 42 Thieving), fight through to the Fire Warrior of Lesarkus (level 84, kill with ice arrows, Protect from Magic negates damage), then hand Winelda 20 unnoted limpwurt roots at once to be teleported across the lava (one-way, no going back - caution for ironmen). Optionally grab a shiny key for a dungeon shortcut. Push through to the Guardians of Armadyl room and pick a side to finish.
summary: Choose a side between Lucien and the Guardians of Armadyl, then defeat the Fire Warrior of Lesarkus.

notes: Short intro quest gating Guardians of the Rift. Get the eye amulet from Wizard Persten, use it on the Mage of Zamorak at Varrock's Altar of Chaos, buy (don't steal, or a 10-minute lockout) a strong tea from the Tea Seller to bribe him into an Abyss teleport, then use the amulet on the Dark Mage and solve a colour-matching rift puzzle (touch runic colours until all are white; order is random per player) to receive an abyssal incantation. Return to Persten, teleport to the Wizards' Tower, hand the incantation to Archmage Sedridor, then solve three apprentice riddles with Traiborn (the answer is 11). Finish with a guided Guardians of the Rift tutorial: assemble/charge guardians, mine and grind guardian fragments into essence, and power the Great Guardian at the Mind and Water altars.
summary: Short intro quest unlocking Guardians of the Rift via an eye amulet, an Abyss rift puzzle, and apprentice riddles.

notes: Talk to Captain Tock at the crossroads north of Port Sarim, agree to help, then meet him again on the single dock west of Rimmington to sail to Corsair Cove. On arrival speak to Ithoi the Navigator first (west along the beach, upstairs) or the other NPC dialogues break. Talk to Arsen the Thief and Cabin Boy Colin (same upstairs room, first house west of docks) and Gnocci the Cook (upstairs NW building, grab a tinderbox and a spade nearby if needed) about their 'curses'. Get the ogre artefact from Captain Tock, return it to Chief Tess in the Corsair Cove Dungeon. Dig a sand lump near the tropical tree by the fishing spot, use the telescope on Ithoi's hut deck, then report findings back to Gnocci, Arsen, and Colin. Question the same four NPCs again about who's the real traitor, culminating in confronting Ithoi twice, torching driftwood under his hut with your tinderbox to catch him not-sick, and reporting to Captain Tock. Enter the instanced fight and kill Ithoi the Navigator (level 35, protect from magic negates his damage), then report the kill to Captain Tock to finish. start.location: Exam Centre, south of the Digsite (3361,3340)

notes: Talk to an examiner to attempt (and auto-fail) a first exam, then get a sealed letter from Curator Haig Halen at Varrock Museum. North of the Exam Centre near the blue urn hilltop, search bushes for a teddy bear, take a panning tray, use a cup of tea on the panning guide, pan for a Special cup (and an opal if needed), and pickpocket the nearby workman for an animal skull and specimen brush. Deliver the teddy/cup/skull to the three named students around the dig (NW, E, S respectively, talk twice each). Retake all 3 exams at the Exam Centre picking the correct dialogue options (fail is not possible once you know the answers) to get Level 1/2/3 certificates, re-visiting the students between exams (the female student demands an opal for the 2nd). Save the certificates for the museum curator. Back at the Exam Centre's western room, get a rock pick and specimen jar from cupboards, use the trowel on soil in a level-3 dig site until you find an ancient talisman (can take a while), then talk to Terry Balando and use his invitation on any digsite workman except the one by the western winch. Rope down the western winch to grab arcenia root and search bricks, then rope down the northern winch to talk to Doug Deeping about the rocks. South of the site, unlock a chest for chemical powder, get an unidentified liquid from a barrel (careful — it deals 25 damage and breaks the vial if dropped), grind charcoal, then give the powder/liquid to Terry Balando and mix nitroglycerin+ammonium nitrate, then charcoal, then arcenia root into a chemical compound. Use the compound then a tinderbox on the bricks down the western winch, enter the chamber (watch for level-22 skeletons), grab the stone tablet, and hand it to Terry Balando to finish.

notes: Talk to Bert in Yanille (house next to the POH portal) to get a sandy hand. Buy/bring a beer and give it to the Guard Captain at the Dragon Inn pub south of Bert's house. Ring the bell outside the Wizards' Guild (or enter with 66 Magic) and give the hand to Zavistic Rarve. Get Bert's rota from Bert, travel to Brimhaven, find Sandy south of the Shrimp and Parrot restaurant, search his desk for Sandy's rota, and pickpocket him for sand. Back in Yanille, get a magic scroll from Bert, ring the bell for a magical orb from Zavistic Rarve, who then offers to teleport you to Port Sarim. At Betty's magic shop get bottled water, mix in redberries then white berries (order matters) for pink dye, dye the lantern lens for a rose-tinted lens, then use the lens on the counter from the doorway for a truth serum, and hand over sand. In Brimhaven, distract Sandy with dialogue and use the truth serum on his coffee mug, then activate the magical orb and click through every dialogue option with him. Back in Yanille, ring the bell twice more at the Wizards' Guild (getting a cutscene on the second), sail to Entrana and talk to Mazion at the sandpit for a wizard's head, then return to Yanille and ring the bell/talk to Zavistic Rarve one last time to finish.

notes: Talk to Prince Itzla Arkan at the Teomat, then again after the cutscene. Travel to Quetzacalli Gorge, rent the pub's basement room from the bartender for 30 coins, rest on the bed in the SE room, talk to the Prince, then ask the general store shopkeeper for help and return to talk to the Prince again in the room. Head north through the gate to the Tower of Ascension, talk to the Prince outside, chat with recruits Nova/Sergius/Felius/Caritta, talk to the Prince again (no pets following), then enter the tower and talk to Forebearer Janus to climb up. First Trial: pickpocket a caged Emissary Ascended for a tower key, loot two chests for a book/paper via a word-decode puzzle unique per player, read a resulting poem, and speak the derived passcode to Forebearer Janus on the same floor (don't go downstairs mid-trial or it resets). Second Trial: a wave-based combat encounter where you must heal Prince Itzla with bandages from medical boxes while fighting melee/mage waves. Third Trial: question every cultist and accuse whichever one mentions 'Mictl' (heretical, not part of Emissary beliefs). Final Trial: fight Prince Itzla himself (level ~unlisted) — pray melee against basics, re-enable prayer immediately after his sword-swipe special (which disables it), and run behind him when he telegraphs his AOE special; he's immune to special attacks (unequip a Scythe of Vitur and punch/kick instead). Loot Twilight Emissary robes from a chest, equip them, bring the Prince through the temple east, then descend into the ruins south into an Ice Dungeon: mine through rocks, pull 4 levers scattered through icy rooms while dodging Frost Nagua/frost crabs/traps (each trap deals 10 damage), then pull a chain for future shortcut access. Statue Puzzle: collect 3 coloured icons from urns (level-104 Frost Nagua spawn continuously, Protect from Magic negates their hits), fix broken statues with the icons, then read corner murals to learn a player-specific activation order (Zema/Oma/Yeya/Naui = 1-4) and touch statues in that order to open the frozen door. Final Boss: fight Amoxliatl (level 263) praying magic, avoiding ice pools/spikes, re-enabling Protect from Magic after it's disabled, and meleeing the healing ice blocks she summons (or ignoring them at high level and just maging her). Finish by speaking to Servius, Teokan of Ralos, at the Sunrise Palace.

notes: Talk to Irena south of Shantay Pass to start. At the Desert Mining Camp entrance, goad the Mercenary Captain (level 47, safespottable/cannonable) into attacking via dialogue and kill him for the gate key — do not skip the dialogue or enter without full waterskins, both can get you jailed or killed by heat damage. Unequip all weapons/armour before entering the gate (graceful is fine if not worn over the required desert clothing) — equipping gear or removing the disguise inside gets you jailed. Trade with the male slave on the east wall for slave clothes when no guard is watching (getting caught = jail; escape by bending the window bars, climbing out over the wall/cliff, and re-entering the gate), equip the clothes, and enter the mine north. Follow the path to a guarded cave entrance and talk to a guard until he mentions a Tenti pineapple, then leave the mine, fully unequip the slave robes, and exit camp via the front gate (or fairy ring BIQ) — leaving in disguise through either the gate or the mine door also risks jail. At Bedabin Camp (west of the mining camp) talk to Al Shabim in the south tent for a Bedabin key. Back in the mining camp (slave outfit on again), climb to the jail building's upper floor, search the southernmost west-wall bookcase for a sailing-books clue, then talk to Captain Siad in the same room and open a chest for technical plans. Show the plans to Al Shabim, then use the northern tent's anvil to smith a bronze dart tip from a bar and fletch it with 10 feathers into a prototype dart; trade it to Al Shabim for the Tenti pineapple. Re-suit in slave clothes, give the pineapple to a mine guard, head east past a mine cart, search barrels for a spare barrel, then search the mine cart to trigger a cutscene ride (redo if it doesn't trigger). Do not talk to Ana — instead follow the west-north-west path and use the spare barrel on her (don't try to teleport with her in your inventory, it drops the barrel). Ride the cart back, put Ana in it then get in yourself, search barrels to find her again, place her on the north-west winch bucket, decline the guard's suspicion-raising offer of help, then surface, operate the winch (south-west of camp), search the barrel west of the winch for Ana, load her onto the wooden cart at camp centre, and talk your way past the mine cart driver. Board the cart and return to Irena for the reward. Downstream note: required for starting Desert Treasure I.

notes: One-way point of no return dungeon crawl west of Ardougne toward Tirannwn. Talk King Lathas then Koftik at West Ardougne cave entrance, enter dungeon (no going back except via lever/rope pull). Light an arrow via Koftik's cloth+tinderbox, shoot the bridge guide-rope, cross grid maze carefully (keep HP>15), pull lever. Collect 4 light orbs (avoid wall traps, use plank on flat rocks, disarm trap on 4th), fuel furnace, descend well. Navigate slave-cage/pipe area (50 Thieving shortcut optional). Get unicorn horn via railing-on-boulder trick, kill 3 paladins (safespottable) for badges, use badges+horn on well to open door. Meet dwarves Niloof and Klank (get gauntlets - keep inv slot free), steal Witch's cat to enter her house for loot, kill 3 demons for amulets, brew dwarf beer + tinderbox on tomb. Kill Kalrag the spider (safespottable, ignores Protect Melee), get Iban's dove wearing Klank's gauntlets. Kill a Disciple of Iban for ceremonial robes (required to enter temple), use Doll of Iban on the well in Iban's temple (repeat through his attacks, ~8dmg unblockable spikes) to destroy him. Return to King Lathas via Koftik. Gates access to Tirannwn/Elf lands questline infrastructure.

Next, click the totem and select carving options for a set of nearby spirit animals (randomized per player) to decorate it. Return again, then fletch 4 items (bows/shields) from the same wood as the totem and use them on the totem to finish decorating it. The ents leave an offering to collect, then speak to either NPC to receive Sacraments of ent folk and complete the miniquest, unlocking the minigame proper. No combat.

notes: Grandmaster Mahjarrat-storyline quest, sequel to Defender of Varrock, chasing the Stone of Jas. Thaerisk sends you to kill 2 assassins, then investigate Movario at the Fight Arena: bribe/charm the Khazard Launderer for info, train a broav at Feldip Hills to sniff out Movario's hideout, then break into his underground base solving a rune-symbol door puzzle, a bookcase-lever/wire maze, a trapped bed chest, and a weight/pressure-gauge puzzle to recover two volumes of notes. Rally allies: rescue Idria from mercenaries at McGrubor's Wood, plant a teleorb on a shady stranger near Draynor for Akrisae, get a snapdragon seed from Thaerisk and enrich it with pink dye + Betty's help, plant it at Falador castle. Use NPC Contact to summon Turael/Mazchna/Cyrisus/Duradel about Lucien, harvest the enriched snapdragon for a truth serum to interrogate a captured shady stranger, then recruit Ghommal/Harrallak/Sloane at the Warriors' Guild. Infiltrate Black Knights' Fortress in disguise, descend into the Black Knight Catacombs, farm elite black armour off Elite Black Knights, rescue Silif and swap armour with him, then face Surok Magis (magic-only, 450hp, Vorkath-style attack rotation: bind/weaken his summoned warriors, telegrab-and-alch his explosive orbs, counter his elemental surges with the opposite element) atop the fortress. Teleport to Lucien's camp via a strange teleorb, then descend the Chasm of Tears: collect 4 elemental orbs from braziers, solve elemental-block puzzles inside skull tunnels, and match herblore-ingredient offerings to 8 of 13 statues (offerings vary per player) to open the final door. Finish with the Balance Elemental (524, prayer-switches by its attack style, drains stats every 3-4 hits, doubles up at 25% hp) then two Tormented Demons alongside the Guardians of Armadyl (can be cheesed by letting the Guardians finish them off from behind a pillar) before returning to Idria to complete.

notes: A boy's ball landed in a scary witch's garden. start.location: Jiggig, south of Castle Wars, west of Gu'Tanoth (2444,3051)

notes: Grish asks you to investigate zombified ogres (zogres) infesting the ogre ceremonial grounds. Head into the cave below Jiggig, being careful of disease from zogre/skogre attacks if under 89 combat (carry super restores). Loot a ruined backpack and a torn page from a skeleton/lectern, then pry open a coffin with a knife for a black prism. Head to Yanille, use the recovered Dragon Inn tankard on the bartender there, then visit Zavistic Rarve at the Wizards' Guild. Investigate the ogres' bedridden neighbor Sithik Ints: search his room for a portraiture book, necromancy book, papyrus/charcoal and a Book of 'H.A.M.', read and use all three on him, then sketch a portrait that reads as an honest "classic realist charcoal portrait" (higher Crafting speeds this up) and get it signed by the Dragon Inn bartender. Bring the necromancy book, H.A.M. book, tankard and signed portrait to Zavistic Rarve for a strange potion; spike Sithik's tea with it, then question him for the secrets to Relicym's balm, curing the disease, and removing the undead ogres. Return to Grish for an ogre gate key and to learn comp ogre bow use, then fight the level-111 Slash Bash (uses Ranged+Melee — safespot with Protect from Missiles, or use Crumble Undead) in the ceremonial chamber to finish.
